correctness.rationale: For a fixed support S, each noncentral symbol appears twice; nested occurrence intervals force at most one even palindrome and, in the nested case, one odd palindrome. Without full nesting, three distinct possible odd centers would imply all intervals nested, a contradiction. Equality per support implies pairwise-intersecting intervals, hence a first-occurrence permutation followed by a second-occurrence permutation. Full-support odd centers then force the second half to be fully reversed or to differ solely by exchanging the last two letters first encountered; both forms attain two palindromes per support. Support-size counts yield the exact odd/even histograms. Direct and independently structured exhaustive checkers passed all described finite tests.

value.rationale: A natural balanced boundary n=2q of the published scattered-palindrome maximum has exactly two different equality structures, one palindromic and one not. The full all-q classification resolves a concrete form of the primary paper’s stated equality-characterization direction, gives 2q! labeled optimizers, and exhibits an exact conservation/swap law between even and odd length spectra. It is not a finite next-index observation.
